description: Record a mint intent and get a fee-first calls[] bundle: protocol fee mint first (in the merchant's own loyalty tokens, not USDC), then the recipient mint. Submit both in order (atomically via EIP-5792 if supported), then call confirm_mint_fee with obligation_id, fee_tx_hash, recipient_tx_hash. Unconfirmed fees block future mints. recipient_address takes a 0x Base wallet or a customer email (or use recipient_email); the wallet is resolved server-side.

recipient.description: Legacy alias for recipient_address (0x address or email)

recipient_address.description: Customer 0x Base wallet address or customer email receiving minted tokens. Preferred — matches REST.

recipient_email.description: Customer email address to resolve to their Base wallet
